# ProgressOS API — LLM Context
Version: 2.0.0
Base URL: http://127.0.0.1:8000
Interactive docs: http://127.0.0.1:8000/api-docs
OpenAPI spec: http://127.0.0.1:8000/api-docs/openapi.yaml

## Authentication

Bearer token via Laravel Sanctum. Prefix: pos_
Header: Authorization: Bearer pos_your_token_here
Header: Accept: application/json

Create token: POST /api/tokens
Body: {"name":"BotName","abilities":["read","write","capture"]}
Response includes plain_text_token (shown once only).
Abilities: read, write, capture, reports, tokens

## Quick Capture — primary endpoint for AI/bot integration

POST /api/v1/quick-capture  (ability: capture)
Optional header: Idempotency-Key — deduplicates retried requests for 24h

Required fields: type, title (max 180)
Optional fields: date (YYYY-MM-DD), project_name (max 120), duration_minutes, notes

type values and what they create:
  task           → Task with status=todo
  blocker        → Task with status=blocked
  work_log       → Work Log entry
  daily_progress → Daily Progress entry
  learning       → Learning entry (title used as topic)

Response: {"data":{...},"record":{...},"record_path":"/tasks/42","message":"Captured."}

## All Endpoints

### Auth — Registrasi, login, profil
POST /api/register  — Daftar user baru
  Body: name*, email*, timezone, password*, password_confirmation*
POST /api/login  — Login dengan email dan password
  Body: email*, password*, remember
POST /api/logout  — Logout sesi saat ini
GET /api/me  [read]  — Data user yang sedang login
PATCH /api/profile  [write]  — Update profil
  Body: name*, email*, timezone*, theme*
POST /api/profile/avatar  [write]  — Upload avatar
PUT /api/profile/password  [write]  — Ganti password
  Body: current_password*, password*, password_confirmation*
POST /api/forgot-password  — Kirim link reset password
  Body: email*
POST /api/reset-password  — Reset password dengan token
  Body: token*, email*, password*, password_confirmation*

### Tokens — Manajemen personal access token
GET /api/tokens  [tokens]  — Daftar personal access token
  Returns: { tokens }
POST /api/tokens  [tokens]  — Buat personal access token
  Body: name*, abilities, expires_at
  Returns: { data, token, plain_text_token }
DELETE /api/tokens/{token}  [tokens]  — Cabut personal access token

### Dashboard — Ringkasan metrik dan aktivitas terkini
GET /api/v1/dashboard  [read]  — Metrik dashboard, chart, dan record terbaru
  Returns: Payload dashboard

### Analytics — Chart dan statistik agregat
GET /api/v1/analytics  [read]  — Statistik dan chart agregat
  Returns: { work_heatmap, task_velocity, monthly_work, by_category, task_status, learn_vs_work, totals, productivity_score, habit_weeks, active_goals }

### Standup — Generator laporan standup harian
GET /api/v1/standup  [read]  — Generate laporan standup harian
  Returns: { date, done_logs, completed_tasks, today_tasks, blockers, text }

### Projects — Manajemen proyek
GET /api/v1/projects  [read]  — Daftar proyek aktif
  Returns: { projects }
GET /api/v1/projects/{project}  [read]  — Detail proyek dengan task, work log, dan metrik
  Returns: { project, tasks, workLogs, metrics }
PATCH /api/v1/projects/{project}  [write]  — Update proyek
  Returns: Proyek diperbarui

### Daily Progress — Entri progress harian / end-of-day
GET /api/v1/daily-progress  [read]  — Daftar entri progress harian
  Query: tag, archived
POST /api/v1/daily-progress  [write]  — Buat entri progress harian
  Returns: { entry }

  Returns: { entry }
PATCH /api/v1/daily-progress/{dailyProgress}  [write]  — Update entri progress harian
  Returns: Entri diperbarui
DELETE /api/v1/daily-progress/{dailyProgress}  [write]  — Hapus entri progress harian

### Work Logs — Log sesi kerja dengan project, kategori, dan durasi

  Returns: Work log diperbarui
DELETE /api/v1/work-logs/{workLog}  [write]  — Hapus work log

### Tasks — Manajemen task dengan status, prioritas, dan recurrence

  Query: status, priority, project_id

  Returns: { task }

  Returns: { board }

  Returns: { count }

  Returns: { task }

  Returns: Task diperbarui
DELETE /api/v1/tasks/{task}  [write]  — Hapus task
PATCH /api/v1/tasks/{task}/status  [write]  — Update status task saja
  Body: status*

  Returns: { entry }

  Returns: { categories, monthly, totals }
GET /api/v1/learning/heatmap  [read]  — Heatmap menit belajar 90 hari terakhir
  Returns: { heatmap }
GET /api/v1/learning/{learning}  [read]  — Detail entri belajar
  Returns: { entry }
PATCH /api/v1/learning/{learning}  [write]  — Update entri belajar
  Returns: Entri diperbarui
DELETE /api/v1/learning/{learning}  [write]  — Hapus entri belajar

### Milestones — Milestone dengan auto-progress tracking

  Query: status, target_type, category

  Returns: { milestone }

### Habits — Habit tracking dengan streak dan heatmap
GET /api/v1/habits  [read]  — Daftar habit dengan status hari ini, streak, dan heatmap
  Returns: { habits, today }
POST /api/v1/habits  [write]  — Buat habit baru
  Body: name*, description, color, icon, frequency, target_days
  Returns: { habit }
POST /api/v1/habits/reorder  [write]  — Atur ulang urutan habit
  Body: ids*
  Returns: { reordered }
PATCH /api/v1/habits/{habit}  [write]  — Update habit
  Body: name*, description, color, icon, frequency, target_days, active, archived, ...
  Returns: Habit diperbarui
DELETE /api/v1/habits/{habit}  [write]  — Hapus habit
POST /api/v1/habits/{habit}/log  [write]  — Catat habit selesai untuk tanggal tertentu
  Body: date, notes
  Returns: { logged, date, log_id, streak }
DELETE /api/v1/habits/{habit}/log  [write]  — Batalkan log habit untuk tanggal tertentu
  Query: date
  Returns: { unlogged, date }

  Body: title*, description, period_label, start_date, end_date, status, color, key_results
  Returns: { goal }
GET /api/v1/goals/{goal}  [read]  — Detail goal beserta key results
  Returns: { goal }
PATCH /api/v1/goals/{goal}  [write]  — Update goal
  Body: title, description, period_label, start_date, end_date, status, color
  Returns: Goal diperbarui
DELETE /api/v1/goals/{goal}  [write]  — Hapus goal
POST /api/v1/goals/{goal}/key-results  [write]  — Tambah key result ke goal
  Body: title*, metric_type, current_value, target_value, unit, notes
  Returns: { key_result }
PATCH /api/v1/goals/{goal}/key-results/{keyResult}  [write]  — Update key result
  Body: title*, metric_type, current_value, target_value, unit, notes, status
  Returns: { key_result }
DELETE /api/v1/goals/{goal}/key-results/{keyResult}  [write]  — Hapus key result

  Returns: { count }

DELETE /api/v1/notifications/{notification}  [write]  — Hapus satu notifikasi

  Returns: Sync diperbarui

POST /api/v1/configuration/backup-syncs/{sync}/run  [write]  — Jalankan backup sync sekarang
  Returns: Sync dijalankan

## Request Schemas (write operations)

QuickCaptureRequest:
  type (required): string [task|blocker|work_log|daily_progress|learning] — - `task` → buat task dengan status todo
- `blocker` → buat task dengan status blocked
- `work_log` → buat work log
- `daily_progress` → buat entri progress harian
- `learning` → buat entri belajar

  title (required): string — Judul record (untuk learning dipakai sebagai topic)
  date: string|null — Default ke hari ini
  project_name: string|null — Nama project (untuk work_log dan task)
  duration_minutes: integer|null — Durasi dalam menit (untuk work_log dan learning)
  notes: string|null — Catatan tambahan

TaskRequest:
  project_id: integer|null
  milestone_id: integer|null
  work_log_id: integer|null
  title (required): string
  notes: string|null
  status (required): string [todo|in_progress|done|blocked]
  priority (required): string [low|medium|high|urgent]
  due_date: string|null
  recurrence_rule: string|null [daily|weekly|monthly|custom]
  recurrence_interval: integer|null
  recurrence_days: array|null
  recurrence_ends_at: string|null

WorkLogRequest:
  project_id: integer|null
  task_id: integer|null
  date (required): string
  project_name (required): string
  ticket_code: string|null
  title (required): string
  category (required): string [bug|feature|research|testing|setup|meeting|documentation|refactor|other]
  status (required): string [todo|in_progress|done|blocked]
  priority (required): string [low|medium|high|urgent]
  description: string|null
  resolution_or_outcome: string|null
  estimated_duration: integer|null
  actual_duration: integer|null
  tags: array

DailyProgressRequest:
  date (required): string
  title (required): string
  in_progress: string|null
  todo: string|null
  blockers: string|null
  notes: string|null
  completed_items: array
  mood: string|null
  archived: boolean
  tags: array

LearningRequest:
  date (required): string
  topic (required): string
  category (required): string [programming|english|japanese|german|books|career|other]
  source_type (required): string [book|article|video|course|practice|podcast|other]
  duration_minutes (required): integer
  progress_notes: string|null
  takeaway: string|null
  next_action: string|null
  rating: integer|null

MilestoneRequest:
  title (required): string
  category (required): string
  target_type (required): string [count|duration|streak|custom]
  source_type: string [manual|work_log_count|work_log_minutes|learning_minutes|daily_progress_streak|task_done_count]
  source_filter: string|null
  target_value (required): number
  current_value: number
  start_date: string|null
  end_date: string|null
  status (required): string [active|paused|completed|cancelled]
  notes: string|null

HabitRequest:
  name (required): string
  description: string|null
  color: string|null
  icon: string|null — Emoji
  frequency: string [daily|weekly]
  target_days: array|null

GoalRequest:
  title (required): string
  description: string|null
  period_label: string|null
  start_date: string|null
  end_date: string|null
  status: string [draft|active|completed|abandoned]
  color: string|null
  key_results: array — KR yang langsung dibuat bersama goal

KeyResultRequest:
  title (required): string
  metric_type: string [percentage|number|boolean]
  current_value: number|null
  target_value: number|null
  unit: string|null
  notes: string|null

SavedViewRequest:
  module (required): string [tasks|work-logs|daily-progress|learning|milestones]
  name (required): string
  filters (required): object — Object filter bebas sesuai query params modul
  pinned: boolean

ReferenceRequest:
  referenceable_type (required): string [task|work_log|learning|milestone|daily_progress]
  referenceable_id (required): integer
  label (required): string
  url (required): string
  type (required): string [link|doc|ticket|pr|article|course|other]
  notes: string|null

DocRequest:
  title (required): string
  category (required): string
  description: string|null
  reference_urls: array|null

## Response Envelope

Item:       {"data":{...},"message":"...","<key>":{...}}
Collection: {"data":[...],"<key>":[...]}
Paginated:  {"data":[...],"meta":{"current_page":1,"last_page":3,"total":55,"per_page":20},"links":{"prev":null,"next":"..."},"<key>":[...]}

Named response keys per module:
  daily-progress → entry / entries
  work-logs      → log / logs
  tasks          → task / tasks
  learning       → entry / entries
  milestones     → milestone / milestones
  projects       → project / projects
  habits         → habits
  goals          → goal / goals
  notifications  → notifications
  docs           → doc / docs

## Error Responses

401  {"message":"Unauthenticated."}
403  {"message":"This action is unauthorized."}
422  {"message":"The given data was invalid.","errors":{"field":["Error message."]}}
404  {"message":"Not found."}
